alerts.header: Line 2 Bloor-Danforth: This weekend, there will be no subway service between Warden and Kennedy stations due to planned track work. Shuttle buses will operate.

Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be no subway service between Bloor-Yonge and Osgoode stations, starting 11:59 p.m., nightly Monday, November 30 to Thursday, December 3, due to planned track work. Shuttle buses will operate.
